purpose: 무속성 및 5원소 Space 기본 공격용 투사체 원화. R 고유 능력과 구슬은 별도.

prompts.neutral:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent raster game projectile animation sprite sheet for Element Eater, a cute Korean 2D top-down action game. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its softly painted, rounded, outlined, polished cartoon sprites and warm dark outlines. Do not reproduce the characters, background, labels, or UI.
Create ONE projectile type in EIGHT successive looping flight-animation frames, in a clean exact grid FOUR columns by TWO rows, row-major time order. Wide 2:1 canvas; eight equally sized square cells, with no drawn grid or text. In each cell the projectile flies RIGHT. Keep the leading projectile core at exactly the same position (60% cell width, 50% cell height), the exact same core diameter (24% of cell width), scale and orientation through all eight frames. Only the trailing elemental energy, surface details, small particles evolve smoothly across the eight frames; last-to-first should loop smoothly. Entire art fits inside the inner 80% of each cell, isolated with generous completely transparent gutters; no art touching a neighboring cell. Full projectile length about 65% of cell width. Actual transparent background and genuine alpha, no checkerboard pattern, matte, floor, cast shadow, UI, labels, lettering, face, hands, characters or target. Readable at small in-game size. This is a SMALL SINGLE Space basic-attack shot, NOT a large R special skill, not an collectible elemental orb.
Subject and material: IVORY NEUTRAL IMPACT PELLET: a compact solid pearl/ivory rounded compressed puff with a subtle warm cream highlight and warm brown fine outline. Two or three soft white speed wisps trail LEFT. Clearly physical-looking soft impact pellet, restrained smooth soft-air motion, no green leaves, no other elemental colors, no explosions.
